name: list_read_files
description: List the files read via read_file in this session (deduped, most recent first). Each entry shows the path relative to the working directory, the absolute path, the last-read time, and a status: 'unchanged', 'changed' (file mtime is newer than the last read), or 'missing'. Use it to recall paths you read earlier - e.g. when the user says a previously-read file was updated and you must re-read the same path - instead of re-locating files with find/execute_command. Prefer re-reading a known path over re-searching.

path.description: Optional substring filter on the file path (relative or absolute); only matching entries are listed.
